title: Trump’s foreign licensing business booms to $59.5 million as Gulf developers pay
summary_full: Nearly two-thirds of Trump’s foreign licensing fees came from two Gulf developers, in the UAE and Qatar, including one pursuing a $20 billion U.S. expansion.
